decisions.reason: Although the men's care series builds on the firm's natural-cosmetics know-how, it is a narrower adjacent niche than the core assortment, so with limited visible evidence of follow-up support the firm would likely reallocate resources to areas where its existing knowledge base can be applied more reliably.

The cleansing foam is very close to the firm's established facial-care capabilities and was presented as a direct extension of an existing series, so absorptive capacity is high and management would be inclined to keep and refine it rather than withdraw it.
